name: Boeing F/A-18E Super Hornet

published.source: Boeing / US Navy fact sheet as commonly quoted (en.wikipedia 'Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet'): 60 ft 1.25 in x 44 ft 8.5 in (over the wingtip launchers) x 16 ft

engine.row: cfighter_n, the US carrier fighter of the e00 and e20 decks; drawn by js/hero/us_f18_family.js (key 'E'), which also draws nato_e90_cfighter (F/A-18C), nato_e00_ewair and ew_n (EA-18G).
engine.current_nodes: one engine node, the group 'gear' (hidden in flight); no 'wingfold' groups (tools/jsc/wingfold_check.js does not list the F/A-18).
engine.span: drawn 12.84 m over the tip launchers, not the published 13.62 m: the game scales an aircraft by length and the airbase revetments (tools/jsc/parked3d_check.js B) leave room for 12.86 m. The wing is cut 0.4 m short of its tip; planform and stations otherwise the drawing's (see the file header, THE SPAN).

references.name: [D1] YF-17 / F/A-18 / F/A-18E/F silhouettes, plan
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Northrop YF-17 McDonnell Douglas FA-18 Boeing FA-18EF Super Hornet.png' (not stored here; read for the first build, see the file header)
references.note: Plan silhouettes at one scale, fixed to the published lengths. Read off it: the LEX 0.55 m off the centreline 3.7 m aft of the radome tip growing to a straight 1.94 m shoulder at 7.75 m, the wing leading edge starting again at 8.9 m and sweeping about 29 deg, the horizontal tail tip 3.6 m off the centreline at 17.1 m. Kept as a reviewer reference only: no copy is in specs/ref, so outline.py skips it.

references.name: [D2] F/A-18E/F three-view
references.note: For the fin (canted 20 deg outward) and the canopy line.

references.name: [P1] EA-18G head-on, VAQ-138, RED FLAG-Alaska 2026
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'EA-18G pair of NGJ-MB pods and a single TJS pod on centerline.jpg' (US Marine Corps photograph; not stored here)
references.note: Same airframe as the E: main wheels about 3.2 m apart, the rectangular caret intakes under the wide LEX, the wing flat (no dihedral), tanks on the inboard stations. Its squadron colours are NOT to be drawn.

must_show: rectangular (caret) intake mouths under the LEX, one each side at y 0.74 - 1.28 m, h 1.20 - 2.24 m above the ground, their lips 6.45 m aft of the radome tip (x +2.70) - NOT the legacy Hornet's rounded D mouths
the wide LEX: a blade from 0.55 m off the centreline at 3.7 m aft of the nose (x +5.45) to a straight shoulder 1.94 m out at 7.75 m (x +1.40), running into the wing leading edge at 8.9 m (x +0.25)
a larger trapezoidal wing, leading edge swept about 29 deg, the AIM-9X launcher rails on the tips (y +-6.27)
twin fins canted 20 deg outward, leading edge from 13.1 m to 15.0 m aft (x -3.9 .. -5.8), tips 4.9 m above the ground
the all-moving horizontal tail set low under the fins, tips 3.6 m off the centreline at 17.1 m aft (x -7.95)
two F414 nozzles side by side at y +-0.72 m, ending at 18.05 m aft (x -8.9)
a single-seat bubble canopy from 3.7 m to 7.6 m aft of the nose (x +5.5 .. +1.5) with the dark anti-glare panel ahead of it
tricycle gear: twin nose wheels with the catapult launch bar ahead of the leg (x +5.1 .. +5.7), single main wheels 3.2 m apart under the wing root (x -0.6)

the loads of the row, hung at x -1.5 .. +2.5: AIM-9X tips (y +-6.27), AIM-120 outboard (y +-4.5), GBU-32 JDAM mid-wing (y +-3.5), 480 gal tanks inboard (y +-2.3), ATFLIR on the port cheek and AIM-120 on the starboard cheek (y +-1.02)
plain paint over the whole airframe (x -9.2 .. +9.2): FS 36320-like grey upper, a lighter grey belly, panel lines, hinge lines, no insignia, numbers or squadron marks

landmarks.name: LEX shoulder half-width at 7.75 m aft
landmarks.note: [D1] the straight LEX shoulder 1.94 m off the centreline at 7.75 m aft of the radome tip (model x = 9.155 - 7.75 = 1.405)

landmarks.name: LEX start half-width at 3.7 m aft
landmarks.note: [D1] the LEX 0.55 m off the centreline 3.7 m aft of the nose (x 5.455); the fuselage side there is about as wide, so the point is the outer skin

landmarks.name: horizontal tail tip off the centreline
landmarks.note: [D1] the stabilator tip 3.6 m off the centreline at 17.1 m aft

landmarks.name: main wheel half-track
landmarks.note: [P1] main wheels about 3.2 m apart, read off the head-on photograph scaled on the tank pair (2.3 m off the centreline); a photograph, so 0.08 m

landmarks.name: fin tip height (published height)
landmarks.note: published height 16 ft = 4.88 m over the fin tips; the gear stands on z = -1.90, so 2.98

not_confirmed: the span is cut to 12.84 m (see engine.span); the tip chord is therefore 1.7 m, not 1.4 m
the wing-fold seam station (drawn at y 4.05 m, between the mid and outboard pylons): no reference here gives the E/F hinge station
the fittings' stations (pitots, AoA vanes, louvres, blade aerials, beacons, frame seams) are the legacy Hornet's, scaled 1.073 / 1.047 / 1.10 like the body tables: NOT measured on a Super Hornet
the paint: authored so that it shows at the game camera as a sunlit FS 36320 / 36375 grey (HeroKit.authorFor of #a7afb4 / #c6cbce), not measured off a photograph
the wheelbase (5.75 m as drawn) and the gear leg lengths
